# NovaEyes

> NovaEyes is a performance-based clipping agency founded in 2025 by Andrea Corindo in Ferrara, Italy. Clients fund a view pool and pay per 1,000 verified short-form views, delivered by a network of 20,000 clippers across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and X. Campaigns start at $3,000, and they launch within 24 hours of the onboarding call. Every campaign can be locked to the countries and audience the client chooses (age, gender): only views from that audience count, and clips that miss it are not paid, even if they go viral. Audience data is shown in the client dashboard and every report.

## Clipping by vertical

- [Gaming clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/gaming-clipping): gameplay, trailers, updates and esports cut into clips that push wishlists, downloads and players
- [Music clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/music-clipping): songs pushed through thousands of clips to drive streams
- [Podcast clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/podcast-clipping): episodes cut into clips that bring new listeners
- [Sports clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/sports-clipping): match footage, highlights and behind the scenes from any sport, cut into short clips
- [Combat sports clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/combat-sports-clipping): fight footage turned into highlight clips
- [App and startup clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/app-and-startup-clipping): demo clips, founder clips and TikTok slideshows that drive downloads and sign-ups for apps, SaaS and AI tools
- [Logo clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/logo-clipping): a brand's logo, promo code and link on clips that already perform
- [Product clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/product-clipping): creators showing a product in new short clips

## Clipping by location

Each page covers the audience size (DataReportal, Digital 2026), the local ad disclosure rules with a source, and our results there.

- [Clipping agency in the United States](https://nova-eyes.com/clipping-agency/united-states): 153M TikTok users 18+
- [Clipping agency in the UK](https://nova-eyes.com/clipping-agency/united-kingdom): 26.8M TikTok users 18+
- [Clipping agency in Germany](https://nova-eyes.com/clipping-agency/germany): 23.7M TikTok users 18+, campaigns in German and English
- [Clipping agency in Austria](https://nova-eyes.com/clipping-agency/austria): 2.49M TikTok users 18+, campaigns in German
- [Clipping agency in Switzerland](https://nova-eyes.com/clipping-agency/switzerland): 2.46M TikTok users 18+, campaigns in German and English
- [Clipping agency in Italy](https://nova-eyes.com/clipping-agency/italy): 22.0M TikTok users 18+, NovaEyes is based in Italy
- [Clipping agency in Spain](https://nova-eyes.com/clipping-agency/spain): 20.9M TikTok users 18+
- [Clipping agency in France](https://nova-eyes.com/clipping-agency/france): 23.4M TikTok users 18+

- [Clipping agency in Australia](https://nova-eyes.com/clipping-agency/australia): 10.9M TikTok users 18+

## Selected results

- Alex Schor (music): 189,974,866 views at $0.13 CPM across 2,444 clips in 4 months; Spotify monthly listeners grew from 170K to 650K
- BRAVE CF (combat sports): 52,131,046 views at $0.21 CPM across 5,247 clips in 6 weeks; estimated $700K revenue impact
- Oktagon MMA (combat sports, Oktagon 94 Frankfurt): 20,833,959 views across 5,297 clips in 19 days at €0.36 CPM; one YouTube Short reached 5.79M views
- Ahmed Amwell: 8.4M views at $0.36 CPM on a $3,000 budget, 1,706 clips in 20 days
- Family Ties (podcast with Tobi Brown): 7.2M views at $0.41 CPM on a $3,000 budget, 843 clips; 2M+ additional YouTube views
- Sparkle (music): 4.7M views at $0.21 CPM in 3 days

All figures come from NovaEyes campaign dashboards.
